about: The mutant ledger of the IR build path's coverage and agreement tooling (internal/experimental/irspike and the IR builder in internal/sketch/lower/ir*.go). Its killers need the IR toolchains or the full tier; see toolchain/ir/ports.md. Without the toolchains (ERGO_IRSPIKE_GOROOT_SOURCE, ERGO_IRSPIKE_GOROOT_IR, ERGO_IRSPIKE_CACHE) the agreement tests skip and their rows survive, so run the ledger with the toolchains set. The patch-level mutant port-stock-not-identical (a planted codegen change outside the -ergoir guard) is an edit of the Go patch, run with scripts/irport -patch, not here. The derivative's own mutants live outside this repository and are recorded here by name only (go-irspike, wf10 IR1 round 1): M1 the decoder swaps binary operands, M2 drops the else branch, M4 the IR path builds with bounds checks off (-B), all killed by TestIRMatchesSource; M6 the decoder accepts a type mismatch, killed by TestIRBodyThatDoesNotCheck. TestIRRuntimeChecks (race detector, GC checkmark) was deleted in batch-18 fix-tool: it guarded only the derivative's stack and pointer maps, and no mutant of this repository reached it.

mutants.rule: An IR node carries its .ergo line, so the derivative reports an IR body that does not check at the source position.

mutants.origin: wf10 batch-18 fix-tool (verify M2, the IR1 request's M5)
mutants.rule: The -ergoir flag, the one key of the IR in Go's build cache, names the IR file's content, not the module it was written in: an edit of the IR alone, in the same module, builds again (each seed of TestIRMatchesSource writes its own module, so only this test sees the difference).
